issue.title: Ingest a checked GitHub Issue revision into a Tactus WorkOrder
issue.body:
## Objective

Provide the minimal successor WorkSource path needed for the first vertical slice with immutable Issue provenance.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Persist every required source field and exact-body/specification hashes from the baseline contract.
- [ ] Same revision import is idempotent; edited source does not silently rewrite a running or approved WorkOrder.
- [ ] Readiness/authorization and freshness are rechecked at claim/dispatch; stale/unavailable source causes a typed hold.
- [ ] Children preserve parent Issue provenance; completing one child does not close the Issue.
issue.author: walsamer
